source_binding.publication: Sadeghi et al. (2026), Journal of Hydrology 673, 135467

structural_mass_gate.interpretation: These are inherited structural conservation thresholds, not scientific donor-accuracy tolerances.

steady_sand.interpretation: Both representations are at machine-negligible error; this is an identity/steady regime, not useful donor evidence.

bounded_apparent_improvement_check.observation: The deepest layer of the two infiltration cases has VZAA RMSE below LayeredMFP RMSE in both refinements.
bounded_apparent_improvement_check.reason: Both representations are already at approximately 1e-10 cm/d absolute error, individual-step wins are a minority, and the same VZAA term is orders of magnitude worse higher in the same profiles.

temporal_refinement.observation: VZAA errors are generally stable under the factor-two refinement rather than converging toward a distinct useful correction; the strong-gradient VZAA RMSE fine/coarse ratios are approximately 0.999 to 1.000.
temporal_refinement.interpretation: The adverse stress-case signal is refinement-robust. The infiltration correction direction is not sufficiently stable and its magnitude remains far too large.

history_and_switching.history_evaluation_cost: grows linearly with accepted history length in the literal Eq. 5 implementation
history_and_switching.interpretation: D0-A failure is not primarily caused by c-switch chatter.

reporting_erratum.problem: The initial aggregate summary grouped switch counting by layer only and therefore counted transitions between different cases/refinements as if they belonged to one trajectory.
reporting_erratum.raw_rows_reanalysis: Exactly two real trajectory-local switches; all decision logic in this result uses trajectory-local counting.

precommit_falsification_findings: VZAA diagnostic is consistently less accurate than LayeredMFP in redistribution and all strong-gradient cases.
The correction direction is systematically wrong in redistribution_sand and both clay strong-gradient cases.
Where direction is correct in strong-gradient sand, correction magnitude is typically 5x to 16x the needed correction and VZAA is never closer to the oracle.
In infiltration cases the direction fraction changes materially with refinement and median correction magnitude remains tens of times larger than the needed correction.
The only broad case where VZAA is uniformly closer is steady_sand, where both errors are at machine-negligible scale and H contributes no useful dynamic information.
The only layer-local RMSE improvement occurs where LayeredMFP is already approximately exact and therefore does not justify unbounded history cost.
claim_limit: This rejects the published VZAA Eq. 3/5/6/15/17 relation as a useful diagnostic flux donor/correction for the tested LayeredMFP D0-A regimes. It does not claim that the complete published sequential VZAA algorithm cannot reproduce its reported benchmarks, and it is not an official MATLAB-code reproduction because the supplementary code has not been captured.
